headline: A 2020 law requires the U.S. Mint to issue $1 coins honoring President George H.W. Bush and bullion coins honoring First Spouse Barbara Bush for one year.
what_it_does: The law requires the issuance of $1 coins with an image of President George H.W. Bush. It also requires bullion coins with an image of Barbara Bush. Both requirements apply for one year, starting January 1, 2020.
when_it_takes_effect: The coin issuance period is set to begin January 1, 2020, which is before the law was enacted on January 27, 2020, so the official summary does not fully explain the start date.
